mcq_fix.s: Which one of the following is NOT a scheme or initiative of the Department of Science and Technology (DST)?
mcq_fix.why: odd wording 'in the material listed'; Ramalingaswami = DBT

patterns: APPSC asks full-form traps: SHE = Scholarship for Higher Education, not 'Support for Her Education' (APPSC 2022).
Scheme-to-target items recur: WIDUSHI = senior women in interdisciplinary S&T; brain-gain list (VAJRA, Ramanujan, INSPIRE) with an off-list distractor.
Partner/parent-body items: JIGYASA = CSIR + KVS; AIM set up under NITI Aayog (asked by both APPSC and UPSC).
App MCQs match these shapes closely; extra items on PARAM hosts, NM-ICPS outlay and 2026 budget figures go deeper than PYQs.
